mapper.sql: fingerprint, rule_code, subject, severity, phase, state, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, occurrences, resolved_at, acknowledged_at, acknowledged_by, observed, threshold, why, action, window_label
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_event (fingerprint, rule_code, subject, severity, phase, state, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, occurrences, resolved_at, observed, threshold, why, action, window_label) VALUES (#{fingerprint}, #{ruleCode}, #{subject}, #{severity}, #{phase}, 'OPEN', #{at}, #{at}, 1, NULL, #{observed}, #{threshold}, #{why}, #{action}, #{windowLabel}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE state = CASE WHEN state = 'ACKNOWLEDGED' THEN 'ACKNOWLEDGED' ELSE 'OPEN' END, last_seen_at = VALUES(last_seen_at), occurrences = occurrences + 1, resolved_at = NULL, severity = VALUES(severity), observed = VALUES(observed), threshold = VALUES(threshold), why = VALUES(why), action = VALUES(action), window_label = VALUES(window_label)
mapper.update: UPDATE alert_event SET state = 'RESOLVED', resolved_at = #{at} WHERE fingerprint = #{fingerprint}
UPDATE alert_event SET state = 'ACKNOWLEDGED', acknowledged_at = #{at}, acknowledged_by = #{by} WHERE fingerprint = #{fingerprint} AND state <> 'RESOLVED'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM alert_event WHERE state <> 'RESOLVED' ORDER BY severity, first_seen_at, fingerprint
SELECT FROM alert_event ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC, fingerprint LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alert_event WHERE state = 'OPEN'
